source.text: אֵיכָה֩ יָעִ֨יב בְּאַפּ֤וֹ׀אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן הִשְׁלִ֤יךְ מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־זָכַ֥ר הֲדֹם־רַגְלָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: How covers-with-a-cloud in his anger [the] Lord the daughter of Zion! He has thrown from heavens [to] earth [the] splendor of Israel, and not has he remembered [the] footstool of his feet in [the] day of his anger.

en.L: How the Lord in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud! \q He has thrown down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has not remembered the footstool of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet in the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.
en.B: How the Lord in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger has covered Daughter Zion with a cloud! \q He has hurled the splendor of Israel down from heaven to earth; \q in the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave no thought to the footstool of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.R: How the Lord has covered the people of Zion with the dark cloud of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger! \q He threw the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the ground. \q When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was angry, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not even remember {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} footstool, the temple.

pt.L: Como o Senhor, na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira, cobriu de nuvem a filha de Sião! \q Lançou do céu à terra o esplendor de Israel, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não se lembrou do estrado dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés no dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.
pt.B: Como o Senhor, na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira, encobriu com uma nuvem a filha de Sião! \q Atirou do céu à terra o esplendor de Israel; \q no dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira, não fez caso do estrado dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.R: Como o Senhor cobriu o povo de Sião com a nuvem escura da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira! \q Ele jogou a beleza de Israel do céu ao chão. \q Quando ficou irado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nem se lembrou do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} estrado, o templo.

es.L: ¡Cómo ha cubierto de nube el Señor en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira a la hija de Sion! \q Ha arrojado del cielo a la tierra el esplendor de Israel, \q y no se ha acordado del estrado de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies en el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: ¡Cómo ha oscurecido el Señor con una nube, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, a la hija de Sion! \q Ha lanzado desde el cielo hasta la tierra el esplendor de Israel; \q en el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira no tuvo en cuenta el estrado de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.R: ¡Cómo ha cubierto el Señor al pueblo de Sion con la nube oscura de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira! \q Arrojó la belleza de Israel desde el cielo hasta el suelo. \q Cuando se enojó, ni siquiera se acordó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} estrado, el templo.

fr.L: Comme le Seigneur, dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, a couvert d’un nuage la fille de Sion ! \q Il a jeté du ciel à la terre la splendeur d’Israël, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est pas souvenu du marchepied de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds au jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.B: Comme le Seigneur, dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, a enveloppé d’un nuage la fille de Sion ! \q Il a précipité du ciel jusqu’à terre la splendeur d’Israël ; \q au jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est pas soucié du marchepied de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Comme le Seigneur a couvert le peuple de Sion du nuage sombre de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ! \q Il a jeté la beauté d’Israël du ciel jusqu’au sol. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était en colère, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est même pas souvenu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} marchepied, le temple.

vi.L: Than ôi! Chúa trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lấy mây che phủ con gái Si-ôn! \q Ngài đã ném sự huy hoàng của Y-sơ-ra-ên từ trời xuống đất, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không nhớ đến bệ chân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong ngày cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Than ôi! Trong cơn giận, Chúa đã phủ mây đen trên con gái Si-ôn! \q Ngài đã quăng sự huy hoàng của Y-sơ-ra-ên từ trời xuống đất; \q trong ngày nổi giận, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng còn nghĩ đến bệ chân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Than ôi! Chúa đã phủ đám mây đen của cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên dân Si-ôn! \q Ngài ném vẻ đẹp của Y-sơ-ra-ên từ trời xuống đất. \q Khi nổi giận, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng nhớ đến cả bệ chân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là đền thờ.

ko.L: 어찌하여 주님께서 진노하셔서 딸 시온을 구름으로 덮으셨는가! \q 그분께서 이스라엘의 영화를 하늘에서 땅으로 내던지시고, \q 그분의 진노의 날에 그분의 발등상을 기억하지 않으셨다.
ko.B: 어찌하여 주님께서 진노하셔서 딸 시온을 먹구름으로 뒤덮으셨는가! \q 이스라엘의 영화를 하늘에서 땅으로 내던지시고, \q 진노하시던 날에 그분의 발등상도 돌아보지 않으셨다.
ko.R: 슬프다! 주님께서 화가 나셔서 시온 백성을 먹구름으로 덮으셨다. \q 이스라엘의 아름다움을 하늘에서 땅바닥으로 내던지셨다. \q 화가 나셨을 때, 그분의 발등상인 성전조차 기억하지 않으셨다.

sw.L: Jinsi Bwana katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} alivyomfunika binti Sayuni kwa wingu! \q Ameitupa kutoka mbinguni hadi duniani fahari ya Israeli, \q wala hakukumbuka kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika siku ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Jinsi Bwana katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} alivyomfunika Binti Sayuni kwa wingu! \q Ameitupa fahari ya Israeli chini kutoka mbinguni hadi duniani; \q katika siku ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} hakukijali kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Jinsi Bwana alivyowafunika watu wa Sayuni kwa wingu jeusi la hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}! \q Aliutupa uzuri wa Israeli chini kutoka mbinguni hadi ardhini. \q Alipokasirika, hakukumbuka hata kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, yaani hekalu.

decisions.choice: an alphabet poem: twenty-two verses, one for each letter
decisions.reason: Like chapters 1 and 4, this chapter is an acrostic: each of its twenty-two verses begins with the next letter of the Hebrew alphabet, from aleph here to taw in verse 22. Here the letter pe (verse 16) comes before ayin (verse 17), the reverse of the order in chapter 1; chapter 3 (verses 46-51) and chapter 4 (verses 16-17) do the same. Some early alphabet inscriptions found in Israel also put pe before ayin, so the poet may be following an older order of the letters. The verses keep the three-line lament rhythm described at 1:1.

decisions.choice: How ...!: a cry of grief and shock, and the book's Hebrew title
decisions.reason: The word ('ekhah) is an exclamation, not a question: the cry of a mourner over the dead (compare Isaiah 1:21; Jeremiah 48:17), here over a fallen city. It opens chapters 1, 2 and 4, and it is the Hebrew name of the book.

decisions.choice: has covered with a cloud: has darkened her in his anger
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here. It is usually taken from the word for a cloud: God's anger settles over Zion like a dark cloud, where once his cloud of glory filled the temple (1 Kings 8:10-11). Others link it to a different root meaning "to treat with contempt" or "to disgrace".

decisions.choice: the footstool of his feet: the ark and the temple on Zion
decisions.reason: The ark of the covenant and the temple where it stood are called God's footstool (1 Chronicles 28:2; Psalm 99:5; 132:7). "The splendor of Israel" is the same city and temple, the pride of the nation, flung down like a star falling from the sky (Isaiah 14:12).

decisions.choice: the poet speaks about Zion, and the Lord is the one acting
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 ended with Zion speaking (1:22). Here the poet's voice returns and describes Zion from outside, through verse 10. Almost every verb in verses 1-8 has the Lord as its subject: the enemy's work is described as his.

decisions.choice: the people of Zion ... his footstool, the temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Zion" for "daughter of Zion", as Isaiah does: the city is pictured as a daughter, and the picture stands for its people. It also names the temple, which the footstool stands for (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: How ...!
decisions.reason: As at 1:1, every level keeps "How" with an exclamation mark (m2).

decisions.choice: "¡Cómo ...!", as in 1:1
decisions.reason: The book's opening cry returns at the head of the second poem and is written the same way at every level.

decisions.choice: "Than ôi!" for "ʾekah", as in 1:1
decisions.reason: The book's title word keeps one wording at the head of each poem; see 1:1.

source.text: בִּלַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֜י וְלֹ֣א חָמַ֗ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־נְא֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֔ב הָרַ֧ס בְּעֶבְרָת֛וֹ מִבְצְרֵ֥י בַת־יְהוּדָ֖ה הִגִּ֣יעַ לָאָ֑רֶץ חִלֵּ֥ל מַמְלָכָ֖ה וְשָׂרֶֽיהָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has swallowed up [the] Lord, and not has he spared, all [the] pastures of Jacob; he has torn down in his fury [the] strongholds of [the] daughter of Judah; he has brought [them] to the ground; he has profaned [the] kingdom and its princes.

en.L: The Lord has swallowed up, and has not spared, all the dwellings of Jacob; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has torn down in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fury the strongholds of the daughter of Judah, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has brought [them] to the ground; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
en.B: The Lord has swallowed up without pity all the settlements of Jacob; \q in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fury {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah and brought them down to the ground; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has dishonored the kingdom and its officials.
en.R: The Lord swallowed up all the homes of Jacob's people and showed no pity. \q In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fury {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tore down the forts of the people of Judah and knocked them to the ground. \q He brought shame on the kingdom and its leaders.

pt.L: O Senhor tragou, e não poupou, todas as moradas de Jacó; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} derrubou no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} furor as fortalezas da filha de Judá, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [as] lançou por terra; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} profanou o reino e os seus príncipes.
pt.B: O Senhor tragou sem piedade todos os povoados de Jacó; \q no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} furor derrubou as fortalezas da filha de Judá e as lançou por terra; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} desonrou o reino e os seus oficiais.
pt.R: O Senhor engoliu todas as casas do povo de Jacó e não teve pena. \q No {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} furor {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} derrubou as fortalezas do povo de Judá e as jogou no chão. \q Ele envergonhou o reino e os seus líderes.

es.L: El Señor ha devorado, y no ha tenido piedad, todas las moradas de Jacob; \q ha derribado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor las fortalezas de la hija de Judá, las ha echado por tierra; \q ha profanado el reino y a sus príncipes.
es.B: El Señor ha devorado sin piedad todos los poblados de Jacob; \q en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor ha derribado las fortalezas de la hija de Judá y las ha echado por tierra; \q ha deshonrado el reino y a sus jefes.
es.R: El Señor se tragó todos los hogares del pueblo de Jacob, y no tuvo piedad. \q En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo derribó las fortalezas del pueblo de Judá y las tiró al suelo. \q Cubrió de vergüenza al reino y a sus dirigentes.

fr.L: Le Seigneur a englouti, et n’a pas épargné, toutes les demeures de Jacob ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a renversé dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur les forteresses de la fille de Juda, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [les] a fait toucher terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a profané le royaume et ses chefs.
fr.B: Le Seigneur a englouti sans pitié tous les villages de Jacob ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a démoli les forteresses de la fille de Juda et les a abattues jusqu’à terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déshonoré le royaume et ses chefs.
fr.R: Le Seigneur a englouti toutes les maisons du peuple de Jacob et n’a eu aucune pitié. \q Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a démoli les forteresses du peuple de Juda et les a jetées à terre. \q Il a couvert de honte le royaume et ses dirigeants.

vi.L: Chúa đã nuốt chửng, và đã không thương xót, mọi chỗ ở của Gia-cốp; \q trong cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phá đổ các đồn lũy của con gái Giu-đa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm [chúng] sập xuống đất; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ô uế vương quốc và các thủ lĩnh của nó.
vi.B: Chúa đã nuốt chửng không chút thương xót mọi làng mạc của Gia-cốp; \q trong cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phá đổ các đồn lũy của con gái Giu-đa và san bằng chúng xuống đất; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nhục vương quốc và các quan chức của nó.
vi.R: Chúa đã nuốt chửng mọi nhà cửa của dân Gia-cốp mà chẳng chút thương xót. \q Trong cơn giận dữ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phá đổ các đồn lũy của dân Giu-đa và làm chúng sập xuống đất. \q Ngài làm cho vương quốc và các nhà lãnh đạo của nó bị sỉ nhục.

ko.L: 주님께서 야곱의 모든 거처를 삼키시고 아끼지 않으셨다. \q 그분께서 격노하셔서 딸 유다의 요새들을 허무시고 땅에 내리치셨다. \q 그분께서 나라와 그 고관들을 욕되게 하셨다.
ko.B: 주님께서 야곱의 모든 마을을 사정없이 삼키셨다. \q 격노하셔서 딸 유다의 요새들을 허무시고 땅바닥에 무너뜨리셨다. \q 나라와 그 관리들을 욕되게 하셨다.
ko.R: 주님께서 야곱 자손의 집들을 모두 삼키시고 불쌍히 여기지 않으셨다. \q 몹시 화가 나셔서 유다 백성의 요새들을 허물어 땅바닥에 내리치셨다. \q 나라와 그 지도자들을 부끄럽게 하셨다.

sw.L: Bwana amemeza, wala hakuhurumia, makao yote ya Yakobo; \q amebomoa katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali ngome za binti Yuda, ameziangusha chini; \q ameutia unajisi ufalme na wakuu wake.
sw.B: Bwana amemeza bila huruma makao yote ya Yakobo; \q katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali amebomoa ngome za Binti Yuda na kuziangusha chini; \q ameuaibisha ufalme na maafisa wake.
sw.R: Bwana aliyameza makazi yote ya wazao wa Yakobo bila kuonyesha huruma. \q Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali alibomoa ngome za watu wa Yuda na kuziangusha chini. \q Aliuletea aibu ufalme na viongozi wake.

decisions.choice: dwellings: the open settlements and pasture lands
decisions.reason: The word means pasture grounds and the homes of shepherds and farmers in open country. Set beside "strongholds", it covers the whole land: first the unwalled villages, then the fortified towns.

decisions.choice: has profaned: has stripped of its honor as something set apart
decisions.reason: The verb means to treat what is holy as common. The kingdom of David's line was set apart by God (Psalm 89:4-5); now God himself has thrown its honor to the ground (Psalm 89:40).

decisions.choice: daughter of Judah: the people of Judah pictured as a young woman
decisions.reason: As with "daughter of Zion" (verse 1), the land and its people are pictured as a daughter, one who could be loved, shamed and mourned.

decisions.choice: and has not spared
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "not" alone; the reading tradition adds "and". The sense is the same either way: he swallowed up without pity.

decisions.choice: officials (Balanced), leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for the king's chief men (sar) is "princes" at Literal, as in Isaiah and Jeremiah; Balanced and Readable use "officials" and "leaders", since they were not the king's sons.

decisions.choice: Jacob's people ... the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable shows that Jacob and the daughter of Judah stand for the people.

decisions.choice: "piedad" for "spare"
decisions.reason: "Not sparing" recurs through the chapter (2:17, 21). Spanish says "no tener piedad", keeping "compasión" for the different word (rahamim) of 3:22 and 3:32.

source.text: גָּדַ֣ע בָּֽחֳרִיאַ֗ף כֹּ֚ל קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב אָח֛וֹר יְמִינ֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וַיִּבְעַ֤ר בְּיַעֲקֹב֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ לֶֽהָבָ֔ה אָכְלָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ס

records.literal_gloss: He has cut off in [the] heat of anger every horn of Israel; he has turned back backward his right hand from before [the] enemy; and he has burned in Jacob like a fire of flame [that] consumes all around.

en.L: He has cut off in burning anger every horn of Israel; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has drawn back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand from before the enemy, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes all around.
en.B: In blazing anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cut down all the strength of Israel; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has pulled back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand in the face of the enemy; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has blazed through Jacob like a flaming fire that devours everything around it.
en.R: In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke all of Israel's strength. \q He pulled back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and did not protect them when the enemy attacked. \q He burned through the people of Jacob like a fire that destroys everything around it.

pt.L: Ele cortou no ardor da ira todo chifre de Israel; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} retirou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita de diante do inimigo, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ardeu em Jacó como um fogo flamejante que consome tudo ao redor.
pt.B: Com ira ardente {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abateu toda a força de Israel; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} recolheu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita diante do inimigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se alastrou por Jacó como fogo em chamas que devora tudo ao redor.
pt.R: Na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira terrível {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quebrou toda a força de Israel. \q Ele recolheu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita e não protegeu o povo quando o inimigo atacou. \q Ele queimou o povo de Jacó como um fogo que destrói tudo ao redor.

es.L: Ha cortado en ardiente ira todo cuerno de Israel; \q ha retirado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha frente al enemigo, \q y se ha encendido en Jacob como fuego llameante que consume todo alrededor.
es.B: En el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira ha quebrado toda la fuerza de Israel; \q ha retirado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha ante el enemigo; \q ha ardido contra Jacob como un fuego en llamas que devora todo a su alrededor.
es.R: En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} terrible enojo acabó con toda la fuerza de Israel. \q Retiró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha y no los protegió cuando el enemigo atacó. \q Ardió contra el pueblo de Jacob como un fuego que destruye todo lo que encuentra.

fr.L: Il a abattu dans l’ardeur de la colère toute corne d’Israël ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a retiré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite devant l’ennemi, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brûlé dans Jacob comme un feu flamboyant qui dévore tout autour.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère brûlante, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé toute la force d’Israël ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a retiré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite face à l’ennemi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a embrasé Jacob comme un feu flamboyant qui dévore tout alentour.
fr.R: Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère terrible, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé toute la force d’Israël. \q Il a retiré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite et ne les a pas protégés quand l’ennemi a attaqué. \q Il a brûlé le peuple de Jacob comme un feu qui détruit tout autour de lui.

vi.L: Trong cơn giận phừng phừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chặt đứt mọi sừng của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rút tay phải của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại trước mặt kẻ thù, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cháy bừng trong Gia-cốp như ngọn lửa hừng thiêu nuốt mọi thứ chung quanh.
vi.B: Trong cơn giận bừng bừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bẻ gãy mọi sức mạnh của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã rút tay phải lại khi kẻ thù kéo đến; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cháy bừng khắp Gia-cốp như ngọn lửa thiêu nuốt mọi vật chung quanh.
vi.R: Trong cơn giận dữ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ gãy hết sức mạnh của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ngài rút tay phải lại, không bảo vệ họ khi kẻ thù tấn công. \q Ngài thiêu đốt dân Gia-cốp như ngọn lửa hủy diệt mọi thứ chung quanh.

ko.L: 그분께서 타오르는 진노로 이스라엘의 모든 뿔을 꺾으셨다. \q 원수 앞에서 그분의 오른손을 뒤로 거두시고, \q 사방을 삼키는 불꽃같이 야곱 가운데서 타오르셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 불타는 진노로 이스라엘의 힘을 모두 꺾으셨다. \q 원수가 닥쳐올 때에 그분의 오른손을 거두셨다. \q 주위를 모두 삼키는 불길처럼 야곱을 휩쓸며 타오르셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 몹시 화가 나셔서 이스라엘의 힘을 모두 꺾으셨다. \q 원수가 쳐들어올 때 오른손을 거두시고 그들을 지켜 주지 않으셨다. \q 주위의 모든 것을 태워 버리는 불처럼 야곱 자손을 태우셨다.

sw.L: Amekata katika hasira kali kila pembe ya Israeli; \q ameurudisha nyuma mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume mbele ya adui, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amewaka katika Yakobo kama moto wa miali unaoteketeza pande zote.
sw.B: Katika hasira inayowaka amezikata nguvu zote za Israeli; \q ameurudisha nyuma mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume adui alipokuja; \q amewaka katikati ya Yakobo kama moto wa miali unaoteketeza kila kitu kandokando.
sw.R: Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali alizivunja nguvu zote za Israeli. \q Aliurudisha nyuma mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume, wala hakuwalinda adui alipowashambulia. \q Aliwaka kati ya wazao wa Yakobo kama moto unaoteketeza kila kitu kinachouzunguka.

decisions.choice: horn: strength and power
decisions.reason: A horn is the strength of a wild ox, and so stands for power and pride (1 Samuel 2:1, 10; Psalm 75:11). Every horn cut off means all Israel's strength broken. The same picture returns in verse 17, where God raises the horn of Zion's enemies.

decisions.choice: his right hand: God's own hand, held back from helping
decisions.reason: God's right hand was the hand that fought for Israel (Exodus 15:6, 12). Now he draws it back when the enemy comes, and so Israel is left without defense. "His" could also be Israel's right hand, made useless in battle, but the Lord is the subject of every other verb in the verse.

decisions.choice: burned in Jacob: his anger spread through the people like fire
decisions.reason: Fire stands for God's anger, which spreads until nothing is left (Deuteronomy 32:22; Jeremiah 4:4).

decisions.choice: strength
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the horn stands for (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: did not protect them when the enemy attacked
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what the drawn-back hand meant for Israel (meaning decision m2).

source.text: דָּרַ֨ךְ קַשְׁתּ֜וֹ כְּאוֹיֵ֗ב נִצָּ֤ב יְמִינוֹ֙ כְּצָ֔ר וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֔ג כֹּ֖ל מַחֲמַדֵּי־עָ֑יִן בְּאֹ֨הֶל֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן שָׁפַ֥ךְ כָּאֵ֖שׁ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: He has bent his bow like an enemy, standing [with] his right hand like a foe, and he has killed all [the] delights of [the] eye; in [the] tent of [the] daughter of Zion he has poured out like fire his wrath.

en.L: He has bent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow like an enemy, with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand set like a foe, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has killed all that was precious to the eye; \q in the tent of the daughter of Zion {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath like fire.
en.B: He has strung {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow like an enemy, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand poised like a foe; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has killed everyone who was a delight to see; \q on the tent of Daughter Zion {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rage like fire.
en.R: He bent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow like an enemy. His right hand was ready to strike like a foe. \q He killed everyone we loved to look at. \q He poured out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger like fire on the homes of the people of Zion.

pt.L: Ele retesou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco como um inimigo, com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita firmada como um adversário, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} matou tudo o que era precioso aos olhos; \q na tenda da filha de Sião {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} derramou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} furor como fogo.
pt.B: Ele retesou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco como um inimigo, com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita pronta como a de um adversário; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} matou todos os que eram um encanto para os olhos; \q sobre a tenda da filha de Sião {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} derramou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fúria como fogo.
pt.R: Ele preparou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco como um inimigo. A {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita estava pronta para atacar como a de um adversário. \q Ele matou todos aqueles que amávamos ver. \q Ele derramou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira como fogo sobre as casas do povo de Sião.

es.L: Ha tensado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco como un enemigo, con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha firme como un adversario, \q y ha matado todo lo que era precioso a los ojos; \q en la tienda de la hija de Sion ha derramado como fuego {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor.
es.B: Ha tensado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco como un enemigo, con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha lista como un adversario; \q ha matado a todos los que eran un deleite para la vista; \q sobre la tienda de la hija de Sion ha derramado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} furor como fuego.
es.R: Tensó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco como un enemigo. Su mano derecha estaba lista para atacar como un adversario. \q Mató a todos los que nos encantaba mirar. \q Derramó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo como fuego sobre los hogares del pueblo de Sion.

fr.L: Il a tendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc comme un ennemi, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite dressée comme un adversaire, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tué tout ce qui était précieux aux yeux ; \q dans la tente de la fille de Sion, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répandu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur comme un feu.
fr.B: Il a bandé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc comme un ennemi, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite prête comme celle d’un adversaire ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tué tous ceux qu’on aimait regarder ; \q sur la tente de la fille de Sion, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déversé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur comme un feu.
fr.R: Il a tendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc comme un ennemi. Sa main droite était prête à frapper comme celle d’un adversaire. \q Il a tué tous ceux que nous aimions regarder. \q Il a déversé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère comme un feu sur les maisons du peuple de Sion.

vi.L: Ngài đã giương cung của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như kẻ thù, với tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt sẵn như kẻ địch, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết mọi điều quý giá trước mắt; \q trong lều của con gái Si-ôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra như lửa.
vi.B: Ngài đã giương cung như một kẻ thù, tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẵn sàng như một kẻ địch; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết mọi người từng làm vui mắt; \q trên lều của con gái Si-ôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trút cơn thịnh nộ như lửa.
vi.R: Ngài giương cung như một kẻ thù. Tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẵn sàng ra đòn như kẻ địch. \q Ngài giết hết những người mà chúng tôi yêu quý. \q Ngài trút cơn giận như lửa trên nhà cửa của dân Si-ôn.

ko.L: 그분께서 원수처럼 활을 당기시고, 대적처럼 그분의 오른손을 [들고] 서셔서, \q 눈에 보기 좋던 모든 것을 죽이셨다. \q 딸 시온의 장막에 그분의 진노를 불처럼 쏟으셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 원수처럼 활시위를 메우시고, 대적처럼 오른손을 치켜드시고, \q 보기에 귀하던 사람들을 모두 죽이셨다. \q 딸 시온의 장막 위에 진노를 불같이 쏟으셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 원수처럼 활을 당기셨다. 오른손은 적처럼 칠 준비가 되어 있었다. \q 우리가 아끼던 사람들을 모두 죽이셨다. \q 시온 백성의 집에 분노를 불처럼 쏟으셨다.

sw.L: Ameupinda upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kama adui, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume umesimama kama mtesi, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amewaua wote waliokuwa wa thamani machoni; \q katika hema la binti Sayuni ameimwaga ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama moto.
sw.B: Ameufunga upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kama adui, mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume tayari kama mtesi; \q amewaua wote waliopendeza macho; \q juu ya hema la Binti Sayuni ameimwaga ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama moto.
sw.R: Aliupinda upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kama adui. Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume ulikuwa tayari kupiga kama mtesi. \q Aliwaua wote tuliopenda kuwatazama. \q Aliimwaga hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama moto juu ya nyumba za watu wa Sayuni.

decisions.choice: bent his bow: strung it, ready to shoot
decisions.reason: The verb means "to tread": an archer pressed one end of a large bow down with his foot to string it (Psalm 7:13; Jeremiah 46:9).

decisions.choice: like an enemy: he acts as an enemy would
decisions.reason: The Lord is not said to have become Zion's enemy in name, but he does what an enemy does. The comparison returns in verse 5.

decisions.choice: all that was precious to the eye: the people Zion loved
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of a man's wife (Ezekiel 24:16) and of sons and daughters (Ezekiel 24:21, 25). Here it means the young men and children who were Zion's delight, though it may also include the temple's treasures (1:10).

decisions.choice: the tent of the daughter of Zion: her dwelling, the city itself
decisions.reason: "Tent" is an old word for home (Jeremiah 4:20; 10:20). It may point to the temple, but more likely to the city as Zion's home.

decisions.choice: the homes of the people of Zion
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the tent stands for (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: "furor" (L, B), "enojo" (R)
decisions.reason: God's wrath (hemah) is "furor" at Literal and Balanced and "enojo" at Readable through these books, leaving "ira" for the commoner word for anger ('af).

decisions.choice: "ghadhabu" (L, B), "hasira" (R) for chemah (wrath); "hasira" for 'af (anger), "hasira kali" for 'evrah (fury)
alternatives: "hasira" at every level for every word
decisions.reason: Lamentations piles up words for God's anger. Swahili keeps chemah apart as "ghadhabu" at Literal and Balanced, as in Ezekiel; Readable uses the everyday "hasira" throughout.

source.text: הָיָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י׀כְּאוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כָּל־אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑יו וַיֶּ֨רֶב֙ בְּבַת־יְהוּדָ֔ה תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַאֲנִיָּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has become [the] Lord like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel; he has swallowed up all its palaces; he has ruined its strongholds; and he has multiplied in [the] daughter of Judah mourning and moaning.

en.L: The Lord has become like an enemy; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has swallowed up Israel, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has swallowed up all its palaces, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has ruined its strongholds; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and moaning.
en.B: The Lord has become like an enemy: \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has swallowed up Israel, swallowed up all its palaces, and laid its strongholds in ruins; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has heaped up mourning and moaning in Daughter Judah.
en.R: The Lord acted like an enemy. \q He destroyed Israel completely. He wiped out all its palaces and ruined its forts. \q He made the people of Judah cry and grieve more and more.

pt.L: O Senhor tornou-se como um inimigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tragou Israel, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tragou todos os seus palácios, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arruinou as suas fortalezas; \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} multiplicou na filha de Judá lamento e lamentação.
pt.B: O Senhor se tornou como um inimigo: \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tragou Israel, tragou todos os seus palácios e deixou em ruínas as suas fortalezas; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} amontoou lamento e lamentação na filha de Judá.
pt.R: O Senhor agiu como um inimigo. \q Ele destruiu Israel por completo. Acabou com todos os seus palácios e arruinou as suas fortalezas. \q Ele fez o povo de Judá chorar e sofrer cada vez mais.

es.L: El Señor ha llegado a ser como un enemigo; \q ha devorado a Israel, ha devorado todos sus palacios, ha arruinado sus fortalezas; \q y ha multiplicado en la hija de Judá lamento y lamentación.
es.B: El Señor se ha portado como un enemigo: \q ha devorado a Israel, ha devorado todos sus palacios y ha dejado en ruinas sus fortalezas; \q ha amontonado luto y lamento sobre la hija de Judá.
es.R: El Señor actuó como un enemigo. \q Destruyó a Israel por completo. Acabó con todos sus palacios y arruinó sus fortalezas. \q Hizo que el pueblo de Judá llorara y sufriera cada vez más.

fr.L: Le Seigneur est devenu comme un ennemi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a englouti Israël, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a englouti tous ses palais, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit ses forteresses ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a multiplié chez la fille de Juda le deuil et la lamentation.
fr.B: Le Seigneur est devenu comme un ennemi : \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a englouti Israël, englouti tous ses palais, et réduit en ruines ses forteresses ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accumulé chez la fille de Juda le deuil et les gémissements.
fr.R: Le Seigneur a agi comme un ennemi. \q Il a complètement détruit Israël. Il a anéanti tous ses palais et ruiné ses forteresses. \q Il a fait pleurer et gémir de plus en plus le peuple de Juda.

vi.L: Chúa đã trở nên như kẻ thù; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nuốt chửng Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nuốt chửng mọi cung điện của nó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phá hủy các đồn lũy của nó; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm gia tăng nơi con gái Giu-đa sự than khóc và than vãn.
vi.B: Chúa đã trở nên như kẻ thù: \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nuốt chửng Y-sơ-ra-ên, nuốt chửng mọi cung điện, và làm các đồn lũy của nó đổ nát; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chất chồng khóc than và than thở trên con gái Giu-đa.
vi.R: Chúa đã hành động như kẻ thù. \q Ngài hủy diệt hoàn toàn Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài phá sạch các cung điện và tàn phá các đồn lũy của nó. \q Ngài làm cho dân Giu-đa ngày càng khóc lóc buồn thương.

ko.L: 주님께서 원수같이 되셨다. \q 그분께서 이스라엘을 삼키시고, 그 모든 궁궐을 삼키시고, 그 요새들을 무너뜨리셨다. \q 그리고 딸 유다에 애통과 통곡을 더하셨다.
ko.B: 주님께서 원수처럼 되셨다. \q 이스라엘을 삼키시고, 그 궁궐들을 모두 삼키시고, 요새들을 폐허로 만드셨다. \q 딸 유다에 애통과 통곡이 넘치게 하셨다.
ko.R: 주님께서 원수처럼 행하셨다. \q 이스라엘을 완전히 멸망시키셨다. 궁궐들을 모두 쓸어버리시고 요새들을 무너뜨리셨다. \q 유다 백성이 울고 슬퍼하는 일이 점점 더 많아지게 하셨다.

sw.L: Bwana amekuwa kama adui; \q ameimeza Israeli, ameyameza majumba yake yote ya kifalme, ameziharibu ngome zake; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ameongeza katika binti Yuda maombolezo na vilio.
sw.B: Bwana amekuwa kama adui: \q ameimeza Israeli, ameyameza majumba yake yote ya kifalme, na kuziharibu ngome zake; \q ameongeza maombolezo na vilio ndani ya Binti Yuda.
sw.R: Bwana alitenda kama adui. \q Aliiangamiza Israeli kabisa. Aliyafutilia mbali majumba yake yote ya kifalme na kuziharibu ngome zake. \q Aliwafanya watu wa Yuda walie na kuhuzunika zaidi na zaidi.

decisions.choice: the Lord has become like an enemy
decisions.reason: The verse sums up verses 1-4. The God who fought for his people now fights against them, as the covenant warned he would (Leviticus 26:17, 24; Deuteronomy 28:63).

decisions.choice: its palaces ... its strongholds: the land and city of Israel
decisions.reason: The first "its" is feminine and the second masculine: the poet moves between Israel as a land or city and Israel as a people. Both mean the same place.

decisions.choice: mourning and moaning: two words from one root
decisions.reason: The two nouns sound alike and come from the same root, as in Isaiah 29:2. Grief is piled on grief.

decisions.choice: mourning and moaning
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use two English words that sound alike, to echo the Hebrew pair (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: destroyed ... completely ... wiped out
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "swallowed up" means.

decisions.choice: lamento e lamentação
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew nouns come from one root and sound alike (m3); "lamento e lamentação", two words from one Portuguese root, keeps the echo, as the English "mourning and moaning" does with sound.

decisions.choice: "lamento y lamentación"
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words come from one root; Literal keeps the echo with two words from one Spanish root. Balanced uses the more natural pair "luto y lamento".

decisions.choice: "애통과 통곡"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pairs two words from one root. "애통" and "통곡" share a syllable and a sound, so Korean keeps something of the echo; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "than khóc và than vãn" (Literal); "khóc than và than thở" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words come from one root; repeating "than" keeps the echo of sound that the English "mourning and moaning" keeps.

source.text: וַיַּחְמֹ֤ס כַּגַּן֙ שֻׂכּ֔וֹ שִׁחֵ֖ת מוֹעֲד֑וֹ שִׁכַּ֨ח יְהוָ֤ה׀בְּצִיּוֹן֙ מוֹעֵ֣ד וְשַׁבָּ֔ת וַיִּנְאַ֥ץ בְּזַֽעַם־אַפּ֖וֹ מֶ֥לֶךְ וְכֹהֵֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he has done violence like a garden [to] his booth; he has ruined his meeting place; has made forgotten YHWH in Zion appointed feast and sabbath; and he has spurned in [the] indignation of his anger king and priest.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done violence to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} booth as [to] a garden, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has ruined {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} meeting place; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has made appointed feast and Sabbath forgotten in Zion, \q and in the indignation of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spurned king and priest.
en.B: He has torn down {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} booth as one strips a garden; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has ruined {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place of meeting; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has wiped out the memory of festival and Sabbath in Zion, \q and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spurned both king and priest.
en.R: He tore down {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple as if it were only a shelter in a garden. He destroyed the place where people met with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made the people of Zion forget the holy festivals and the Sabbath. \q In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rejected both the king and the priest.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez violência à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} cabana como [a] um jardim, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arruinou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar de encontro; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez esquecer em Sião a festa marcada e o sábado, \q e na indignação da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} desprezou rei e sacerdote.
pt.B: Ele derrubou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} cabana como quem desmancha um jardim; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arruinou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar de encontro; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} apagou em Sião a lembrança das festas e do sábado, \q e na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira terrível {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} rejeitou tanto o rei como o sacerdote.
pt.R: Ele derrubou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo como se fosse só uma cabana numa horta. Destruiu o lugar onde o povo se encontrava com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez o povo de Sião esquecer as festas sagradas e o sábado. \q Na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira terrível {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} rejeitou tanto o rei como o sacerdote.

es.L: Y ha hecho violencia a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enramada como [a] un huerto, ha arruinado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar de reunión; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho olvidar en Sion la fiesta señalada y el sábado, \q y en la indignación de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira ha desechado al rey y al sacerdote.
es.B: Ha derribado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enramada como quien despoja un huerto; ha arruinado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar de reunión; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha borrado en Sion el recuerdo de las fiestas y del sábado, \q y en el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira ha rechazado al rey y al sacerdote.
es.R: Derribó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo como si fuera solo una choza en un huerto. Destruyó el lugar donde la gente se reunía con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que el pueblo de Sion olvidara las fiestas sagradas y el sábado. \q En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} terrible enojo rechazó tanto al rey como al sacerdote.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait violence à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} hutte comme [à] un jardin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu de rencontre ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait oublier dans Sion fête fixée et sabbat, \q et dans l’indignation de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rejeté roi et prêtre.
fr.B: Il a démoli {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} hutte comme on saccage un jardin ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu de rencontre ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a effacé dans Sion le souvenir des fêtes et du sabbat, \q et dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ardente {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rejeté le roi comme le prêtre.
fr.R: Il a démoli {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple comme si ce n’était qu’un abri dans un jardin. Il a détruit le lieu où les gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rencontraient. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait oublier au peuple de Sion les fêtes saintes et le sabbat. \q Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère terrible, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rejeté le roi et le prêtre.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phá chòi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như [phá] một khu vườn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hủy hoại nơi hội họp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho kỳ lễ đã định và ngày Sa-bát bị quên lãng tại Si-ôn, \q và trong cơn phẫn nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khinh bỏ vua và thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Ngài đã phá đổ chòi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như người ta phá một khu vườn; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hủy hoại nơi hội họp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khiến Si-ôn quên đi các kỳ lễ và ngày Sa-bát, \q và trong cơn giận dữ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khinh bỏ cả vua lẫn thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Ngài phá đổ đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thể đó chỉ là một cái chòi trong vườn. Ngài phá hủy nơi dân chúng gặp gỡ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} khiến dân Si-ôn quên đi các kỳ lễ thánh và ngày Sa-bát. \q Trong cơn giận dữ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gạt bỏ cả vua lẫn thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 초막을 동산처럼 헐어 버리시고, 그분의 모이는 곳을 무너뜨리셨다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 정한 절기와 안식일을 잊히게 하시고, \q 그분의 맹렬한 진노로 왕과 제사장을 멸시하셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 동산의 원두막을 허물듯 그분의 초막을 허무시고, 백성을 만나시던 곳을 무너뜨리셨다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 절기와 안식일을 잊히게 하시고, \q 맹렬한 진노로 왕과 제사장을 모두 물리치셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 그분의 성전을 밭에 있는 초막처럼 허무셨다. 사람들이 그분을 만나던 곳을 부수셨다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온 백성이 거룩한 절기와 안식일을 잊게 하셨다. \q 몹시 화가 나셔서 왕도 제사장도 버리셨다.

sw.L: Naye amekitendea jeuri kibanda {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kama [kibanda cha] bustani, ameharibu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} pa kukutania; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesababisha sikukuu iliyoamriwa na Sabato kusahauliwa katika Sayuni, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} katika ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} amewadharau mfalme na kuhani.
sw.B: Amekibomoa kibanda {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kama mtu anavyoifyeka bustani; ameharibu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} pa kukutania; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefuta kumbukumbu ya sikukuu na Sabato katika Sayuni, \q na katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali amewakataa mfalme na kuhani pia.
sw.R: Alilibomoa hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kana kwamba ni kibanda tu bustanini. Aliharibu mahali ambapo watu walikutana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafanya watu wa Sayuni wazisahau sikukuu takatifu na Sabato. \q Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali aliwakataa mfalme na kuhani.

decisions.choice: his booth: the temple, pulled down as easily as a garden shelter
decisions.reason: "Booth" is a shelter of branches. Here it is God's dwelling, the temple (compare Psalm 76:3, where his "shelter" is in Salem). "Like a garden" is brief and hard: it may mean he tore it down as one clears a garden, or as one pulls down a watchman's hut in a garden after the harvest (Isaiah 1:8). Either way, what seemed permanent was swept away.

decisions.choice: meeting place ... appointed feast: one word, two senses
decisions.reason: The same word (mo'ed) means first the place where God met his people and then the set times of worship held there. With the temple gone, the festivals and Sabbaths it served are gone too.

decisions.choice: king and priest: the two offices that led the nation
decisions.reason: Both the royal house and the priesthood are rejected. Zedekiah was blinded and taken to Babylon, and the chief priests were executed (2 Kings 25:6-7, 18-21).

decisions.choice: his temple ... the place where people met with him
decisions.reason: Readable names what the booth and the meeting place stand for (meaning decisions m1 and m2).

decisions.choice: "enramada"
decisions.reason: The word is a light shelter of branches, the kind put up in a garden or at the feast of booths; "enramada" keeps the picture of something easily pulled down.

decisions.choice: "chòi" for "his booth"
decisions.reason: The word is a light shelter put up in a garden or field, which is the point of the comparison; "chòi" is that shelter. Readable names the temple, as the English Readable does.

source.text: זָנַ֨ח אֲדֹנָ֤י׀מִזְבְּחוֹ֙ נִאֵ֣ר מִקְדָּשׁ֔וֹ הִסְגִּיר֙ בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֔ב חוֹמֹ֖ת אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ ק֛וֹל נָתְנ֥וּ בְּבֵית־יְהוָ֖ה כְּי֥וֹם מוֹעֵֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has rejected [the] Lord his altar; he has disowned his sanctuary; he has handed over into [the] hand of [the] enemy [the] walls of her palaces; a voice they gave in [the] house of YHWH as [on a] day of appointed feast.

en.L: The Lord has rejected {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} altar, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has disowned {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has handed over into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; \q they raised [their] voice in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as on a day of appointed feast.
en.B: The Lord has cast off {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} altar and disowned {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has handed the walls of her palaces over to the enemy; \q they raised a shout in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as on a festival day.
en.R: The Lord rejected {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own altar. He turned away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple. \q He let the enemy take the walls of Jerusalem's palaces. \q The enemy shouted in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, like people celebrating at a festival.

pt.L: O Senhor rejeitou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} altar, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} repudiou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santuário; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregou na mão do inimigo os muros dos palácios dela; \q levantaram [a] voz na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} como em dia de festa marcada.
pt.B: O Senhor rejeitou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} altar e repudiou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santuário; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregou ao inimigo os muros dos palácios dela; \q gritaram na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} como num dia de festa.
pt.R: O Senhor rejeitou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio altar. Ele se afastou do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo templo. \q Ele deixou o inimigo tomar os muros dos palácios de Jerusalém. \q O inimigo gritou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como gente que comemora numa festa.

es.L: El Señor ha rechazado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} altar, ha repudiado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario; \q ha entregado en mano del enemigo los muros de sus palacios; \q alzaron [la] voz en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como en día de fiesta señalada.
es.B: El Señor ha desechado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} altar y ha repudiado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario; \q ha entregado al enemigo los muros de sus palacios; \q gritaron en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como en un día de fiesta.
es.R: El Señor rechazó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio altar. Se apartó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo templo. \q Dejó que el enemigo tomara los muros de los palacios de Jerusalén. \q El enemigo gritaba en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como la gente que celebra una fiesta.

fr.L: Le Seigneur a rejeté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} autel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répudié {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a livré aux mains de l’ennemi les murs de ses palais ; \q ils ont élevé [la] voix dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} comme en un jour de fête fixée.
fr.B: Le Seigneur a rejeté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} autel et répudié {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a livré à l’ennemi les murs de ses palais ; \q on a poussé des cris dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} comme en un jour de fête.
fr.R: Le Seigneur a rejeté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre autel. Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est détourné de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple saint. \q Il a laissé l’ennemi prendre les murs des palais de Jérusalem. \q L’ennemi a crié dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme des gens qui célèbrent une fête.

vi.L: Chúa đã từ bỏ bàn thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chối bỏ nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phó các tường thành của các cung điện nàng vào tay kẻ thù; \q chúng đã cất tiếng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như trong ngày kỳ lễ đã định.
vi.B: Chúa đã ruồng bỏ bàn thờ và chối bỏ nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nộp các tường thành của cung điện nàng cho kẻ thù; \q chúng reo hò trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như trong ngày lễ hội.
vi.R: Chúa đã từ bỏ chính bàn thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài quay lưng khỏi đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài để kẻ thù chiếm các tường thành của cung điện Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Kẻ thù reo hò trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như người ta mừng lễ hội.

ko.L: 주님께서 그분의 제단을 버리시고, 그분의 성소를 싫어하셨다. \q 그 성의 궁궐 성벽들을 원수의 손에 넘기셨다. \q 그들이 정한 절기의 날처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 소리를 질렀다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그분의 제단을 내버리시고 성소를 외면하셨다. \q 그 성의 궁궐 성벽들을 원수에게 넘겨주셨다. \q 그들이 절기를 지키는 날처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 함성을 질렀다.
ko.R: 주님께서 그분의 제단을 버리셨다. 그분의 거룩한 성전을 외면하셨다. \q 원수가 예루살렘의 궁궐 성벽들을 차지하게 하셨다. \q 원수들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 절기를 즐기는 사람들처럼 소리를 질렀다.

sw.L: Bwana ameikataa madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, amepachukia patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}; \q ametia mkononi mwa adui kuta za majumba yake ya kifalme; \q wamepaza sauti [yao] katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama katika siku ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa.
sw.B: Bwana ameitupilia mbali madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kupakataa mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu; \q amezikabidhi kwa adui kuta za majumba yake ya kifalme; \q wamepiga kelele katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama siku ya sikukuu.
sw.R: Bwana aliikataa hata madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Aliliacha hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu. \q Aliwaacha adui wazitwae kuta za majumba ya kifalme ya Yerusalemu. \q Adui walipiga kelele katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama watu wanaosherehekea sikukuu.

decisions.choice: disowned: rejected with disgust
decisions.reason: This verb is rare; in Psalm 89:40 it is used of God renouncing his covenant with David. Here he renounces his own sanctuary.

decisions.choice: they raised a shout: the enemy soldiers in the temple
decisions.reason: The subject is not named, but it is the enemy of the line before. Their shouts of victory filled the temple courts where Israel's festival songs used to sound (Psalm 74:4).

decisions.choice: her palaces: Zion's
decisions.reason: "Her" is Zion, the city, as through the chapter.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem's palaces ... The enemy shouted
decisions.reason: Readable names the city and the ones who shouted (meaning decisions m2 and m3).

source.text: חָשַׁ֨ב יְהוָ֤ה׀לְהַשְׁחִית֙ חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן נָ֣טָה קָ֔ו לֹא־הֵשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ מִבַּלֵּ֑עַ וַיַּֽאֲבֶל־חֵ֥ל וְחוֹמָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֥ו אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has planned YHWH to destroy [the] wall of [the] daughter of Zion; he has stretched out a line; not has he turned back his hand from swallowing up; and he has made mourn rampart and wall; together they have languished.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} planned to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out a line, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not draw back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand from swallowing up; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made rampart and wall mourn; together they have wasted away.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} resolved to tear down the wall of Daughter Zion; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out the measuring line and did not hold back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand from destroying; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made rampart and wall lament; together they lie in ruins.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} decided to destroy the walls that protected the people of Zion. \q He measured them out for destruction and did not stop until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had destroyed them. \q The walls and the defenses in front of them mourned, and they all crumbled together.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} planejou destruir o muro da filha de Sião; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estendeu o cordel, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não retirou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão de tragar; \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez o antemuro e o muro ficarem de luto; juntos definharam.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} decidiu derrubar o muro da filha de Sião; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estendeu o cordel de medir e não deteve a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão de destruir; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez o antemuro e o muro se lamentarem; juntos estão em ruínas.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} decidiu destruir os muros que protegiam o povo de Sião. \q Ele os mediu para a destruição e não parou enquanto não os destruiu. \q Os muros e as defesas na frente deles ficaram de luto, e tudo desmoronou junto.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se propuso destruir el muro de la hija de Sion; \q extendió el cordel, no retiró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano de devorar; \q e hizo que el antemuro y el muro se enlutaran; juntos han desfallecido.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} decidió derribar el muro de la hija de Sion; \q extendió el cordel de medir y no retiró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano de la destrucción; \q hizo que el antemuro y el muro se lamentaran; juntos yacen en ruinas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} decidió destruir los muros que protegían al pueblo de Sion. \q Los midió para destruirlos y no se detuvo hasta acabar con ellos. \q Los muros y las defensas de delante se pusieron de luto, y todos se derrumbaron juntos.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a projeté de détruire la muraille de la fille de Sion ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu le cordeau, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas retiré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main d’engloutir ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis en deuil rempart et muraille ; ensemble ils ont dépéri.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a décidé d’abattre la muraille de la fille de Sion ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu le cordeau et n’a pas retenu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main de détruire ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait se lamenter rempart et muraille ; ensemble ils gisent en ruine.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a décidé de détruire les murailles qui protégeaient le peuple de Sion. \q Il les a mesurées pour les démolir, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}est pas arrêté avant de les avoir détruites. \q Les murailles et les défenses devant elles étaient en deuil, et elles se sont toutes écroulées ensemble.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định phá hủy tường thành của con gái Si-ôn; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giăng dây đo, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không rút tay lại khỏi việc nuốt chửng; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho thành lũy và tường thành than khóc; chúng cùng nhau mòn mỏi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã quyết định phá đổ tường thành của con gái Si-ôn; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã căng dây đo và không rút tay lại khỏi việc hủy diệt; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khiến thành lũy và tường thành than khóc; tất cả cùng đổ nát.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã quyết định phá hủy các tường thành bảo vệ dân Si-ôn. \q Ngài đo chúng để phá đổ và không ngừng tay cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hủy diệt chúng. \q Các tường thành và lũy chắn phía trước đều than khóc, và tất cả cùng sụp đổ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 딸 시온의 성벽을 허물기로 계획하셨다. \q 줄을 치시고, 삼키는 일에서 그분의 손을 거두지 않으셨다. \q 성루와 성벽이 슬퍼하게 하시니, 그것들이 함께 쇠약해졌다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 딸 시온의 성벽을 헐기로 작정하셨다. \q 측량줄을 치시고, 무너뜨리실 때까지 손을 거두지 않으셨다. \q 성루와 성벽이 통곡하게 하시니, 모두 함께 허물어졌다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온 백성을 지켜 주던 성벽을 무너뜨리기로 하셨다. \q 줄을 띄워 허물 곳을 재시고, 다 허무실 때까지 멈추지 않으셨다. \q 성벽과 그 앞의 방어벽이 슬피 울었고, 모두 함께 무너져 내렸다.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikusudia kuuharibu ukuta wa binti Sayuni; \q alinyosha kamba, hakuurudisha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usimeze; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akalifanya boma na ukuta viomboleze; vyote pamoja vimedhoofika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliazimia kuubomoa ukuta wa Binti Sayuni; \q alinyosha kamba ya kupimia, wala hakuuzuia mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiangamize; \q alilifanya boma na ukuta viomboleze; vyote pamoja vimebaki magofu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamua kuziharibu kuta zilizowalinda watu wa Sayuni. \q Alizipima ili kuziangamiza, wala hakuacha mpaka alipokuwa amezibomoa. \q Kuta na maboma yaliyokuwa mbele yake yaliomboleza, yote yakaanguka pamoja.

decisions.choice: stretched out a line: measured the city for destruction
decisions.reason: A builder's measuring line marked out what was to be built; here it marks out what is to be torn down, carefully and on purpose (2 Kings 21:13; Isaiah 34:11).

decisions.choice: rampart: the outer defensive wall or earthwork
decisions.reason: The word names the outer fortification in front of the main wall (2 Samuel 20:15; Isaiah 26:1).

decisions.choice: rampart and wall mourn: the ruined walls pictured as mourners
decisions.reason: The walls are pictured as people in grief (compare Isaiah 3:26; Jeremiah 14:2). The verb at the end means to waste away, to grow weak and faint.

decisions.choice: the walls that protected the people of Zion ... measured them out for destruction ... did not stop until he had destroyed them
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Zion" for "the daughter of Zion", as in verse 1. Readable explains the measuring line (meaning decision m1) and turns the negative "did not draw back his hand" into plain words.

decisions.choice: o antemuro
decisions.reason: "Antemuro" is the Portuguese word for the outer wall or earthwork built in front of the main wall (m2); "muralha" would be the main wall itself.

source.text: טָבְע֤וּ בָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁעָרֶ֔יהָ אִבַּ֥ד וְשִׁבַּ֖ר בְּרִיחֶ֑יהָ מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְשָׂרֶ֤יהָ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֵ֣ין תּוֹרָ֔ה גַּם־נְבִיאֶ֕יהָ לֹא־מָצְא֥וּ חָז֖וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Have sunk into the ground her gates; he has destroyed and broken her bars; her king and her princes [are] among the nations; there is no instruction; also her prophets have not found a vision from YHWH.

en.L: Her gates have sunk into the ground; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has destroyed and broken her bars; \q her king and her princes [are] among the nations; there is no instruction; \q her prophets also have found no vision from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Her gates have sunk into the ground; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has wrecked and shattered her bars. \q Her king and her officials are among the nations; instruction is no more, \q and her prophets find no vision from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Jerusalem's gates have sunk into the ground. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} smashed the bars that locked them. \q Her king and her leaders now live among foreign nations. There is no more teaching from God. \q Her prophets do not receive any visions from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: As suas portas afundaram na terra; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} destruiu e quebrou as suas trancas; \q o seu rei e os seus príncipes [estão] entre as nações; não há instrução; \q também os seus profetas não encontram visão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: As suas portas afundaram no chão; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} arrebentou e despedaçou as suas trancas. \q O seu rei e os seus oficiais estão entre as nações; já não há instrução, \q e os seus profetas não encontram visão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: As portas de Jerusalém afundaram no chão. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} quebrou as trancas que as fechavam. \q O rei e os líderes dela agora vivem entre nações estrangeiras. Não há mais ensino de Deus. \q Os profetas dela não recebem nenhuma visão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

es.L: Sus puertas se han hundido en la tierra; ha destruido y quebrado sus cerrojos; \q su rey y sus príncipes [están] entre las naciones; no hay instrucción; \q también sus profetas no han hallado visión {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Sus puertas se han hundido en la tierra; ha destrozado y roto sus cerrojos. \q Su rey y sus jefes están entre las naciones; ya no hay instrucción, \q y sus profetas no reciben visión alguna {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Las puertas de Jerusalén se han hundido en la tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo pedazos los cerrojos que las cerraban. \q Su rey y sus dirigentes viven ahora entre naciones extranjeras. Ya no hay enseñanza de Dios. \q Sus profetas no reciben ninguna visión {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Ses portes se sont enfoncées dans la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit et brisé ses barres ; \q son roi et ses chefs [sont] parmi les nations ; il n’y a pas de loi ; \q ses prophètes non plus n’ont pas trouvé de vision venant {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ses portes se sont enfoncées dans le sol ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fracassé et brisé ses barres. \q Son roi et ses chefs sont parmi les nations ; il n’y a plus d’instruction, \q et ses prophètes ne reçoivent aucune vision {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les portes de Jérusalem se sont enfoncées dans le sol. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a cassé les barres qui les fermaient. \q Son roi et ses dirigeants vivent maintenant parmi des nations étrangères. Il n’y a plus d’enseignement de Dieu. \q Ses prophètes ne reçoivent plus aucune vision {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Các cổng thành nàng đã lún xuống đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phá hủy và bẻ gãy các then cửa của nàng; \q vua và các thủ lĩnh của nàng [ở] giữa các dân tộc; không còn sự dạy dỗ; \q các nhà tiên tri của nàng cũng không tìm được khải tượng nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các cổng thành nàng đã lún sâu xuống đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đập tan và bẻ gãy các then cửa của nàng. \q Vua và các quan chức của nàng ở giữa các dân tộc; không còn sự dạy dỗ nữa, \q và các nhà tiên tri của nàng chẳng nhận được khải tượng nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các cổng thành Giê-ru-sa-lem đã lún xuống đất. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đập tan các then khóa cổng. \q Vua và các nhà lãnh đạo của nàng nay sống giữa các dân ngoại. Không còn lời dạy dỗ nào từ Đức Chúa Trời. \q Các nhà tiên tri của nàng không nhận được khải tượng nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그 성의 성문들이 땅속으로 가라앉았고, 그분께서 그 빗장들을 부수고 꺾으셨다. \q 그 성의 왕과 고관들이 민족들 가운데 있고, 가르침이 없다. \q 그 성의 예언자들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 환상을 얻지 못한다.
ko.B: 성문들은 땅에 묻혔고, 그분께서 빗장들을 깨뜨려 부수셨다. \q 왕과 관리들은 이방 민족들 가운데 있고, 가르침은 끊어졌다. \q 예언자들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 환상을 받지 못한다.
ko.R: 예루살렘의 성문들은 땅속에 묻혔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 성문을 잠그던 빗장들을 부수셨다. \q 그 성의 왕과 지도자들은 이제 이방 나라들 가운데서 산다. 하나님의 가르침도 더는 없다. \q 그 성의 예언자들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 아무 환상도 받지 못한다.

sw.L: Malango yake yamezama ardhini; ameharibu na kuvunja makomeo yake; \q mfalme wake na wakuu wake [wako] kati ya mataifa; hakuna sheria; \q manabii wake pia hawapati maono kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Malango yake yamezama ardhini; ameyaharibu na kuyavunja makomeo yake. \q Mfalme wake na maafisa wake wako kati ya mataifa; mafundisho hayapo tena, \q na manabii wake hawapati maono kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Malango ya Yerusalemu yamezama ardhini. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyavunja makomeo yaliyoyafunga. \q Mfalme wake na viongozi wake sasa wanaishi kati ya mataifa ya kigeni. Hakuna tena mafundisho kutoka kwa Mungu. \q Manabii wake hawapati maono yoyote kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: bars: the beams that locked the city gates
decisions.reason: Heavy bars of wood or metal were set across the gates at night and in war (Deuteronomy 3:5; 1 Kings 4:13). With the bars broken and the gates buried in rubble, the city lay open.

decisions.choice: there is no instruction: God's teaching has ceased
decisions.reason: Instruction (torah) was the priests' task, as vision was the prophets' and counsel the elders' (Jeremiah 18:18; Ezekiel 7:26). With the temple gone and the leaders in exile, no one gives God's teaching. The words may also go with the line before: the king and officials are among nations where God's instruction is not known.

decisions.choice: no vision from the LORD: God is silent
decisions.reason: The prophets have nothing from God to say (Psalm 74:9; Ezekiel 7:26; compare 1 Samuel 3:1). Verse 14 says what their visions had been worth before the fall.

decisions.choice: officials (Balanced), leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem's gates ... The LORD smashed ... teaching from God
decisions.reason: Readable names the city and the one who broke the bars, and says whose teaching has ceased (meaning decision m2). "Teaching" follows the wording used for torah in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "instrucción" (L, B), "enseñanza" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah is rendered as in the Spanish Psalms and prophets: God's instruction or teaching, not only a code of law.

decisions.choice: "loi" (L), "instruction" (B), "enseignement" (R) for torah
decisions.reason: The wording settled for God’s torah in the published prophets and Psalms, used here for the teaching that has ceased (m2).

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L), "mafundisho" (B, R) for torah
decisions.reason: As in the Psalms and Jeremiah: torah here is God's teaching given through priests and prophets, which has ceased, not only a code of law. Literal keeps the traditional "sheria".

decisions.choice: "không còn sự dạy dỗ" for "there is no torah"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as God's teaching that has ceased, given through priest and prophet; "luật pháp" would suggest the written law was gone.

source.text: יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בַת־צִיּ֔וֹן הֶֽעֱל֤וּ עָפָר֙ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔ם חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים הוֹרִ֤ידוּ לָאָ֨רֶץ֙ רֹאשָׁ֔ן בְּתוּלֹ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: They sit on the ground, they are silent, [the] elders of [the] daughter of Zion; they have thrown up dust on their head; they have girded on sackcloth; they have brought down to the ground their head, [the] virgins of Jerusalem.

en.L: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground [and] are silent; \q they have thrown dust on their heads, they have put on sackcloth; \q the virgins of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
en.B: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground without a word; \q they have thrown dust on their heads and wrapped themselves in sackcloth; \q the young women of Jerusalem bow their heads low to the earth.
en.R: The elders of Zion sit silently on the ground. \q They throw dust on their heads and put on sackcloth to show their grief. \q The young women of Jerusalem hang their heads down to the ground.

pt.L: Os anciãos da filha de Sião sentam-se no chão [e] estão calados; \q lançaram pó sobre as suas cabeças, vestiram-se de pano de saco; \q as virgens de Jerusalém inclinaram as suas cabeças até o chão.
pt.B: Os anciãos da filha de Sião estão sentados no chão, sem dizer palavra; \q jogaram pó na cabeça e se cobriram de pano de saco; \q as moças de Jerusalém curvam a cabeça até a terra.
pt.R: Os anciãos de Sião ficam sentados no chão em silêncio. \q Jogam pó na cabeça e vestem pano de saco para mostrar a sua tristeza. \q As moças de Jerusalém baixam a cabeça até o chão.

es.L: Se sientan en tierra, guardan silencio los ancianos de la hija de Sion; \q han echado polvo sobre su cabeza, se han ceñido de cilicio; \q las vírgenes de Jerusalén han inclinado hasta la tierra su cabeza.
es.B: Los ancianos de la hija de Sion se sientan en el suelo sin decir palabra; \q se han echado polvo sobre la cabeza y se han vestido de cilicio; \q las muchachas de Jerusalén inclinan la cabeza hasta el suelo.
es.R: Los ancianos de Sion se sientan en silencio en el suelo. \q Se echan polvo sobre la cabeza y se ponen ropa áspera de luto para mostrar su dolor. \q Las muchachas de Jerusalén bajan la cabeza hasta el suelo.

fr.L: Les anciens de la fille de Sion sont assis à terre [et] se taisent ; \q ils ont jeté de la poussière sur leur tête, ils se sont ceints de sacs ; \q les vierges de Jérusalem ont baissé la tête jusqu’à terre.
fr.B: Les anciens de la fille de Sion sont assis par terre sans dire un mot ; \q ils ont jeté de la poussière sur leur tête et se sont couverts d’un sac ; \q les jeunes filles de Jérusalem baissent la tête jusqu’à terre.
fr.R: Les anciens de Sion sont assis par terre en silence. \q Ils jettent de la poussière sur leur tête et mettent des vêtements de sac pour montrer leur deuil. \q Les jeunes filles de Jérusalem baissent la tête jusqu’au sol.

vi.L: Các trưởng lão của con gái Si-ôn ngồi trên đất [và] im lặng; \q họ đã rắc bụi đất lên đầu, họ đã quấn vải thô; \q các trinh nữ của Giê-ru-sa-lem đã cúi đầu xuống đất.
vi.B: Các trưởng lão của con gái Si-ôn ngồi trên đất, lặng thinh; \q họ rắc bụi đất lên đầu và quấn mình trong vải thô; \q các thiếu nữ Giê-ru-sa-lem cúi đầu sát đất.
vi.R: Các trưởng lão Si-ôn ngồi lặng lẽ trên đất. \q Họ rắc bụi lên đầu và mặc vải thô để tỏ lòng đau buồn. \q Các thiếu nữ Giê-ru-sa-lem gục đầu xuống tận đất.

ko.L: 딸 시온의 장로들이 땅에 앉아 잠잠하다. \q 그들이 머리에 티끌을 뿌리고 굵은 베를 둘렀다. \q 예루살렘의 처녀들이 머리를 땅에 숙였다.
ko.B: 딸 시온의 장로들이 말없이 땅바닥에 앉아 있다. \q 머리에 티끌을 뒤집어쓰고 굵은 베옷을 걸쳤다. \q 예루살렘의 젊은 여자들은 머리를 땅에 떨군다.
ko.R: 시온의 장로들이 말없이 땅바닥에 앉아 있다. \q 슬픔을 나타내려고 머리에 흙먼지를 뿌리고 거친 베옷을 입었다. \q 예루살렘의 젊은 여자들은 머리를 땅까지 떨구고 있다.

sw.L: Wazee wa binti Sayuni wanaketi chini [na] kunyamaza; \q wamejitupia mavumbi vichwani, wamejifunga magunia; \q mabikira wa Yerusalemu wameinamisha vichwa vyao hadi chini.
sw.B: Wazee wa Binti Sayuni wanaketi chini bila kusema neno; \q wamejitupia mavumbi vichwani na kujivika magunia; \q wasichana wa Yerusalemu wanainamisha vichwa vyao hadi ardhini.
sw.R: Wazee wa Sayuni wanaketi chini kimya. \q Wanajitupia mavumbi vichwani na kuvaa magunia kuonyesha huzuni yao. \q Wasichana wa Yerusalemu wameinamisha vichwa vyao hadi chini.

decisions.choice: sitting on the ground, dust on the head, sackcloth: signs of mourning
decisions.reason: These were the usual acts of deep grief (Joshua 7:6; Job 2:8, 12-13; Jeremiah 6:26). Sackcloth was rough cloth of goat or camel hair worn by mourners. Silence too belonged to mourning (Job 2:13).

decisions.choice: virgins: young unmarried women
decisions.reason: The word names young women of marriageable age. Set beside the elders, the old men and the young women together stand for the whole population (1:4, 18).

decisions.choice: young women
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the age group the word refers to (meaning decision m2); Literal keeps "virgins".

decisions.choice: to show their grief
decisions.reason: Readable says why they put on sackcloth (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "cilicio" (L, B), "ropa áspera de luto" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Spanish prophets: "cilicio" is the traditional word for the rough mourning garment; Readable describes it.

source.text: כָּל֨וּ בַדְּמָע֤וֹת עֵינַי֙ חֳמַרְמְר֣וּ מֵעַ֔י נִשְׁפַּ֤ךְ לָאָ֨רֶץ֙ כְּבֵדִ֔י עַל־שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־עַמִּ֑י בֵּֽעָטֵ֤ף עוֹלֵל֙ וְיוֹנֵ֔ק בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת קִרְיָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Are spent with tears my eyes; are in turmoil my inward parts; is poured out to the ground my liver over [the] breaking of [the] daughter of my people, as faint child and nursing [infant] in [the] squares of [the] town.

en.L: My eyes are spent with tears, my insides churn; \q my liver is poured out on the ground over the shattering of the daughter of my people, \q as child and nursing infant faint in the squares of the town.
en.B: My eyes are worn out with weeping, my stomach is in turmoil; \q my heart is poured out on the ground because my dear people are shattered, \q as little children and babies faint in the city squares.
en.R: My eyes are worn out from crying. I feel sick deep inside. \q I am overcome with grief because my people have been crushed. \q Little children and babies are fainting in the streets of the city.

pt.L: Os meus olhos se consumiram em lágrimas, as minhas entranhas fervem; \q o meu fígado se derrama por terra por causa da fratura da filha do meu povo, \q enquanto a criança e o bebê de peito desfalecem nas praças da cidade.
pt.B: Os meus olhos estão gastos de tanto chorar, as minhas entranhas se agitam; \q o meu coração se derrama no chão porque o meu querido povo foi despedaçado, \q enquanto criancinhas e bebês desmaiam nas praças da cidade.
pt.R: Os meus olhos estão cansados de tanto chorar. Sinto um mal-estar profundo por dentro. \q Estou arrasado de tristeza porque o meu povo foi esmagado. \q Criancinhas e bebês estão desmaiando nas ruas da cidade.

es.L: Se consumen de lágrimas mis ojos, se revuelven mis entrañas; \q mi hígado se derrama en tierra por el quebranto de la hija de mi pueblo, \q mientras desfallecen el niño y el lactante en las plazas de la ciudad.
es.B: Mis ojos están gastados de tanto llorar, mis entrañas se revuelven; \q mi corazón se derrama por el suelo porque mi querido pueblo está destrozado, \q mientras niños pequeños y bebés desfallecen en las plazas de la ciudad.
es.R: Tengo los ojos cansados de tanto llorar. Me siento enfermo por dentro. \q El dolor me vence, porque mi pueblo ha sido aplastado. \q Los niños pequeños y los bebés se desmayan en las calles de la ciudad.

fr.L: Mes yeux sont consumés de larmes, mes entrailles bouillonnent ; \q mon foie est répandu à terre à cause du désastre de la fille de mon peuple, \q tandis qu’enfant et nourrisson défaillent sur les places de la ville.
fr.B: Mes yeux sont usés à force de pleurer, mes entrailles sont bouleversées ; \q mon cœur se répand à terre, parce que mon cher peuple est brisé, \q tandis que petits enfants et nourrissons défaillent sur les places de la ville.
fr.R: Mes yeux sont usés à force de pleurer. Je me sens malade au fond de moi. \q Je suis accablé de chagrin, parce que mon peuple a été écrasé. \q Des petits enfants et des bébés s’évanouissent dans les rues de la ville.

vi.L: Mắt tôi hao mòn vì nước mắt, ruột gan tôi sôi sục; \q gan tôi đổ tràn trên đất vì sự tan vỡ của con gái của dân tôi, \q khi trẻ con và trẻ còn bú ngất xỉu nơi các quảng trường của thành.
vi.B: Mắt tôi mòn mỏi vì khóc, ruột gan tôi quặn thắt; \q lòng tôi tan nát đổ xuống đất vì dân yêu dấu của tôi bị tan vỡ, \q khi trẻ thơ và trẻ còn bú ngất lịm giữa các quảng trường của thành.
vi.R: Mắt tôi mỏi mòn vì khóc. Lòng tôi đau đớn rã rời. \q Tôi đau buồn tột cùng vì dân tôi đã bị nghiền nát. \q Trẻ con và em bé đang ngất xỉu ngoài các đường phố của thành.

ko.L: 내 눈이 눈물로 쇠하고, 내 창자가 끓어오른다. \q 내 백성의 딸이 부서졌기 때문에 내 간이 땅에 쏟아졌다. \q 어린아이와 젖먹이가 성읍의 광장에서 기절하기 때문이다.
ko.B: 울다 지쳐 내 눈이 짓물렀고, 속이 뒤틀린다. \q 사랑하는 내 백성이 무너졌으니 내 마음이 땅에 쏟아진다. \q 어린아이들과 젖먹이들이 성읍 광장에서 쓰러져 가기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너무 울어서 내 눈이 지쳤다. 속이 아프고 메스껍다. \q 내 백성이 짓밟혔으니 나는 슬픔을 이길 수 없다. \q 어린아이들과 아기들이 성읍 거리에서 기절하고 있다.

sw.L: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa machozi, matumbo yangu yanachafuka; \q ini langu limemwagwa ardhini kwa sababu ya kuvunjika kwa binti wa watu wangu, \q watoto na wanyonyao wanapozimia katika viwanja vya mji.
sw.B: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa kulia, tumbo langu limechafuka; \q moyo wangu umemwagika ardhini kwa sababu watu wangu wapendwa wamevunjika, \q watoto wadogo na wachanga wanapozimia katika viwanja vya mji.
sw.R: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa kulia. Ninaumwa sana ndani yangu. \q Nimeshindwa na huzuni kwa sababu watu wangu wamepondwa. \q Watoto wadogo na wachanga wanazimia katika barabara za mji.

decisions.choice: the poet speaks of himself
decisions.reason: After describing Zion's ruin (verses 1-10), the poet now speaks in the first person of his own grief. From verse 13 he will speak to Zion directly.

decisions.choice: my insides churn ... my liver is poured out: grief felt in the body
decisions.reason: The inner organs were thought of as the seat of feeling (1:20; Jeremiah 4:19). A liver poured out on the ground pictures a grief so deep the poet feels emptied of life.

decisions.choice: the daughter of my people: my people, loved like a daughter
decisions.reason: This phrase, common in Jeremiah (4:11; 8:21-23), pictures the people tenderly as a daughter. It is the poet's own people he weeps for.

decisions.choice: children fainting in the squares: the famine of the siege
decisions.reason: During Babylon's siege of Jerusalem the food ran out (2 Kings 25:3; Jeremiah 52:6). The squares were the open spaces inside the gates where people gathered.

decisions.choice: my heart (Balanced); my dear people (Balanced), my people (Readable)
decisions.reason: In English the heart, not the liver, is the seat of grief, so Balanced says "heart" and Readable "I am overcome with grief"; Literal keeps "liver". "The daughter of my people" is "my dear people" at Balanced and "my people" at Readable, as in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: a filha do meu povo (L); o meu querido povo (B); o meu povo (R)
alternatives: a filha do meu povo (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Jeremiah's Portuguese words the same phrase (Jeremiah 8:21-23): Literal keeps the picture, Balanced keeps its tenderness with "o meu querido povo" (m3), and Readable says "o meu povo". The "breaking" is "fratura" at Literal, as in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "la hija de mi pueblo" (L), "mi querido pueblo" (B), "mi pueblo" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Spanish Jeremiah: the phrase calls the people a beloved daughter; Balanced keeps the tenderness with "querido".

decisions.choice: "enfermo", masculine
decisions.reason: Here the poet speaks of himself, not Zion, so the one adjective that shows gender is masculine.

decisions.choice: "la fille de mon peuple" (L), "mon cher peuple" (B), "mon peuple" (R) for bat-ʿammi, for the whole book
alternatives: "la fille de mon peuple" at every level
decisions.reason: As published Jeremiah 8:21: Balanced keeps the tenderness of the phrase (m3) without the figure, Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "Je suis accablé", masculine
decisions.reason: Here the poet speaks of himself (m1), not Zion, so the agreement is masculine; Literal and Balanced need no agreement in this verse.

decisions.choice: "내 백성의 딸" (Literal); "사랑하는 내 백성" (Balanced); "내 백성" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Jeremiah words bat-'ammi (Jeremiah 8:21), at each level through the book.

decisions.choice: "binti wa watu wangu" (L), "watu wangu wapendwa" (B), "watu wangu" (R)
alternatives: "binti wa watu wangu" at every level
decisions.reason: Bat-'ammi, as in Jeremiah 8:21: Literal keeps the figure, Balanced keeps its tenderness with "wapendwa", Readable says plainly who is meant.

decisions.choice: "con gái của dân tôi" (Literal); "dân yêu dấu của tôi" (Balanced); "dân tôi" (Readable)
alternatives: "con gái dân tôi" at every level
